chapter: Black Benny, brass bands and bass drum
title: Bass drum duets with Baptiste Mosley
summary: Jones and Baptiste Mosley took spontaneous drum solos on parades and he explains how.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: By the way, a couple of years ago you played the parade, I don't remember who all was in the band except Mosley, Baptiste Mosley. Yeah.

And you all put on some stuff and drum solos there. Yeah, I think we're about the only two on the street to do that. That's what I wondered about those. We're about the only two. Did anybody else do it?
Have you ever heard before?
No, never heard before. We're about the only two to do it.
Did you all work them out together or just get together in the spur of the moment?

I just started up one spur of the moment, just like you said. Started up one time, we was playing a one o'clock jump in the brass band. So, guys was taking solos, different ones. So, Bapt said, give us a solo. And we just taking one, him and I, and from then on we just continued doing it. Different numbers we play, we do it.
I heard him and Edgar do it about 10 years ago, too.
Yeah, well, Baptiste and I, before he's when started.
He started. Yeah, I guess he and Edgar.

When you do that, I only heard a part of one chorus or something up there. I was up there, that was a big parade with about four bands. And I wasn't up back with your band until I heard a little bit of that as all. But Ralph told me more about it. Just what do you do? Do you follow the melody and start in your mind? Yeah, in your mind. Play a regular chorus or something?
Yeah, that's right. Just follow that melody. And most of the time I'd be counting to myself, you know.
You were playing snare drum, I guess, were you at that time? No, bass drum.
Bass drum.
Bass drum. I can't even remember.

Baptiste was playing the bass drum. Oh, we'd only do it because I have never tried it on snare drum with nobody else. I play snare on some of the parades, but I have never tried that with anyone else.
You always play the bass drum on those solo.
Yeah. Yeah. That's about the only fellow I imagine that I could do it with, with that. I have never tried it with nobody else.
I wish I could hear some more of that this year. I hope you all get out again. Keep playing much more. I hope we get out again.
You'll hear it. I hope you all get out again.
I hope you all get out again.
In fact, he's the only one I like to play bass drum on the street with. He's a fine drummer, fine, fine drummer.
